ideas.label: Pawn Break
ideas.summary: - Prepare the break with pieces before changing the structure. - The lever should open a line, challenge a chain, or gain a useful square.
games: Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)
Guerra Mansilla, Jorge Maximilian vs Gutierrez Gomez, Nicolas 1999 2026 (E90)

slots.worked: a timely pawn break already improved the structure
slots.attention: the freeing pawn break still needs preparation
slots.lesson: break only with a structural purpose and piece support
slots.plan: prepare the lever, then open the line your pieces can use

ideas.label: Pawn Break
ideas.principle: Target the vulnerable point of the chain
ideas.summary: - Decide whether the head or base of the chain is the real target. - Choose the lever that opens files for your better-coordinated pieces.
games: Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)
Guerra Mansilla, Jorge Maximilian vs Gutierrez Gomez, Nicolas 1999 2026 (E90)

slots.worked: you already challenged the weak point of their chain
slots.attention: the chain still needs a lever at its true weak point
slots.lesson: attack the head or base that opens files for your pieces

ideas.label: Pawn Break
ideas.principle: Time or restrain the hanging-pawn break
ideas.summary: - With hanging pawns, advance only while both are defended and pieces can use the lines. - Against them, restrain the advance, provoke one forward, then attack the weakness left behind.
games: Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)
Guerra Mansilla, Jorge Maximilian vs Gutierrez Gomez, Nicolas 1999 2026 (E90)

slots.worked: hanging-pawn tension is already under control
slots.attention: the hanging-pawn advance still needs timing or restraint
slots.lesson: time the hanging-pawn break only with full defence and open-line follow-up
